text:
The median asking rent in the Mettmann district sits at 10.8 €/m², up 6.2 % year‑on‑year and 25.6 % over the past five years, placing the market 22nd among the 37 most expensive German cities. Asking rents for a typical 60 m² unit total 648 €/month, while the rent‑burden for two residents is 12.5 % of income.  

With a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and 29 days on market, the sector remains balanced but tight; 24 % of listings are let within a week. The asking premium over existing rents is 50 %, reflecting limited supply relative to modest 0.9 % population growth.  

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 11.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.0 €/m² and 11.56 €/m², implying a 4.7 % increase.
